'''Ashlarva''' is a [[Fire]] type [[Healer]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Firecoil]] at 6 bronze stars.

== Overview ==
''"Ashlarva seems more interested in warming up wet companions than in fighting. As for any [[Zobos]] that happen to get singed... Well, they should have stayed back."''

Ashlarva is a purple rarity Tatari. Its name comes from a portmanteau of "ash" and "larva".

==Appearance==
A small, moth-like creature with large eyes, a light yellow body, and orange-red accents on its wings and antennae. Its eyes are reddish brown with pale blue highlights.

Ashlarva's [[Tatari#Glitter Tataris|Glitter]] form changes its body to light beige, and the orange-red accents become more yellow and peach colored. Its eyes also become green.

== Evolution Trial ==
Ashlarva's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Firecoil]] you need to complete the following task:

* Use [[Rubblet]] and Ashlarva on the same team to clear 10 stages.

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Ashlarva wants to be friends with [[Buddi]], but Buddi gets scared every time the pot is shaken up."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Naturally timid, Ashlarva trembles at the slightest fear and stays hidden in dry shrubs to avoid danger."
* Ashlarva/evo and Rubblet/evo are often associated with each other, a parallel to Mothra and Godzilla.
